title: Sample-Aligned Decoders for Latent Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22458v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent generative models synthesize images by decoding generated latents, yet their decoder is trained only to reconstruct encoder latents and never sees the latents it decodes at test time, so the residual errors of the generator are rendered directly into the final image. Existing remedies retrain the generator, add cost at every sampling step, or make the decoder robust to perturbed real latents, assuming that generator errors resemble such perturbations. We find that they do not. Generated latents lie on the encoder latent manifold as closely as real ones, yet follow a different distribution. The decoder should therefore be adapted to the distribution of generated latents, which raises two challenges: (1) unpaired supervision, since a generated latent has no ground-truth image, and (2) latent-space drift, since a decoder freed from paired targets forgets the latent space it must decode. translated_title: 面向潜在生成模型的样本对齐解码器
translated_abstract: 潜在生成模型通过解码生成的潜在表示来合成图像，但其解码器仅被训练用于重建编码器的潜在表示，在测试时从未见过它实际解码的潜在表示，因此生成器的残差误差会被直接渲染到最终图像中。现有的补救措施要么重新训练生成器，要么在每个采样步骤增加开销，要么使解码器对扰动的真实潜在表示具有鲁棒性——后者假设生成器的误差类似于此类扰动。我们发现事实并非如此：生成的潜在表示与真实潜在表示同样紧密地位于编码器潜在流形上，却遵循着不同的分布。因此，解码器应当适应生成潜在表示的分布，这带来了两个挑战：（1）无配对监督，因为生成的潜在表示没有对应的真实图像；（2）潜在空间漂移，因为从配对目标中解放出来的解码器会遗忘它必须解码的潜在空间。我们提出了样本对齐解码器，一种……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出样本对齐解码器（SAD），通过使解码器适应生成潜在表示的分布而非仅重建编码器潜在表示，来阻止生成器的残差误差被渲染进最终图像，并解决了无配对监督与潜在空间漂移两大挑战。
en_tdlr: Proposes Sample-Aligned Decoders (SAD), which adapt the decoder to the distribution of generated latents rather than only reconstructing encoder latents, preventing generator residual errors from being rendered into final images while addressing the challenges of unpaired supervision and latent-space drift.
